messages:
sam: Hey folks — PR #8347 is blocked by a flaky CI failure, can someone take a quick look? Build is failing consistently on one job: integration/kvcache.test :: 'kv eviction race'  :eyes:
ci-bot: Buildkite: Build #8347.1 failed — https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/8347. Failed job: integration/kvcache.test. Rerun: click the job > Retry :repeat:
maya: Pinging for eyes. Can you paste the failing log + the job link? If it's a flake I can kick a single-job rerun now. :+1:
sam: Link above — thanks. Pasting the tail of the failing test log below:
```
FAIL integration/kvcache.test.ts (30.2s)
  kv eviction race › should evict oldest key under memory pressure
  Error: Timeout - test did not finish within 30s
      at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:97:5)
      at Object.<anonymous> (packages/integration/kvcache.test.ts:142:18)
  --- stdout ---
  [kvcache] allocate 4096 MB
  [kvcache] evicting key id=0x12f
  [kvcache] lock wait 5000ms
```

sam: Rerun command we use locally: `yarn test:integration -t "kv eviction" --runInBand --maxWorkers=1` — that reproduces it sometimes on my laptop. On CI it times out more often.
alex: I'll take a look now. From the logs it smells like a timing/race around the eviction lock + GC spike. Quick attempt: bump test timeout to 90s and re-run single job to confirm it's a flake, or run with `CI_FLAKY_RETRIES=3` in the job env.
maya: kicked a single-job retry on Buildkite (integration/kvcache). Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
ci-bot: Buildkite: Retry started for job integration/kvcache (build 8347.2) — https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/8347#job-integration-kvcache
alex: If the rerun passes I'll LGTM the PR (assuming changes are unrelated to the failing test). If it fails again I can add a small guard in the test to make the lock wait deterministic.
lina: Please add `do-not-merge/ci-failed` label if it stays red — we shouldn't ship with flaky coverage.
dave: +1 to the label. If rerun is green I'm fine with merge after an authoritative LGTM.
ci-bot: Buildkite: Job integration/kvcache (build 8347.2) passed — ✅
sam: Thanks all — rerun passed. I added label `ci:flaky` and bumped the timeout on the test in a follow-up branch for a proper fix (PR #8352). Leaving merge to Alex or Maya when you have a sec. :tada:
alex: Quick look, leaving an approval comment. Merge when green and remove the do-not-merge label. :thumbsup:
sam: Appreciated — merging now.
